profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Allstate
profile.summary:
Ever since I was 13 playing with Raspberry Pi's and taking apart computers to see how the whole system worked; I knew that software development was going to be my field of interest.

Being able to build things and solve problems brings so much joy in my life. The ability to learn on the go quickly and efficiently has aided me in every situation that has come at me. I enjoy people and helping everyone to achieve their goals. Feel free to connect with me if Software Development or PC Building is interesting to you.

positions.title: Production Leader | Shift Manager | Training Coordinator

educations.fieldOfStudy: OOP, Ruby on Rails, SQL, TDD, JavaScript, REST API, CRUD
